story.blurb: A man accused of witchcraft demands to see the Inquisitor himself. He has one demonstration to make, and torture waits on the other side of failure.

short.title: The Stolen Kiss
short.blurb: For days he has kept the madness leashed. Then, in the space of a finger-snap, he seizes her, and waits in agony for her to speak.

story.title: Right of Way
story.blurb: A big steamer breaks the rules of the road to pinch a yacht against a reef, with fog rolling in fast. Then the owner starts giving orders.

short.title: The Breaking of the Bow
short.blurb: A king presents a bow that gods, fiends and titans have failed to bend, then invites a young prince to try before the assembled thousands of his court.

story.title: Two Days Too Late
story.blurb: A man returns from years abroad, rich at last, to find the woman he loves newly engaged. He confronts her betrothed with a question neither can escape.

short.title: Half Past Three
short.blurb: An officer strikes matches under his macintosh, counting the minutes until his men charge the trenches in darkness, wondering how many will answer roll call tomorrow.

story.title: A Mare for a Chain
story.blurb: A farmer who brags about his horse trades takes a shine to a young peddler's neck chain. The peddler, very reluctantly, lets himself be talked into a swap.

story.title: Beowulf and Grendel
story.blurb: A hero vows to face a night-fiend bare-handed in a great hall no man has survived after dark. When everything is still, the monster comes.

25551.pairNote: A comic soaking and an anxious night vigil, different scenes and different sisters.

short.title: The Burglar in Blue Calico
short.blurb: Someone is climbing through the back window with great care. Mrs. Dering tiptoes around the corner expecting a burglar and finds something far more drenched.

story.title: The Empty Place at Supper
story.blurb: Supper is called, the cakes are hot, and one sister does not answer. As the clock strikes on through the night, four girls grow quietly frightened.

story.title: The Lantern on the Semaphore
story.blurb: A boy climbs a semaphore with an old switch lantern to flash a telegraph warning across the dark, while angry men race to pull him down.

25919.pairNote: Different subjects entirely: one sketches the Major from a window, the other follows a needling social call on Diva.

short.title: The Old Campaigner
short.blurb: A village spinster's window commands every secret in town, including the Major's unexplained wound, his Indian habits, and the lock of hair he thinks nobody sees him kiss.
short.brokenNote: Otherwise a complete comic portrait, but the final sentence cuts off mid clause.

story.title: Popping In on Diva
story.blurb: Armed with two telltale chintz roses and a rumor about coal fines, a smiling caller sets out to make her dearest rival thoroughly uncomfortable.

25948.pairNote: Two unrelated tales drawn from an anthology of fifty two stories.

short.title: Five Feet of Water
short.blurb: Through a cabin door left ajar, two girls overhear the captain confess what the crew already knows: the ship is leaking faster than the pumps can fight.

story.title: Fifteen Miles After Dark
story.blurb: A wrong carriage strands a girl fifteen miles from home with ninepence, a moonlit road, and rather too much confidence.

25971.pairNote: Two separate stages of the same courtship; the later scene deepens the earlier without repeating it.

short.title: Joey the Pedigree Pom
short.blurb: A landlady's daughter parades seven little dogs upstairs for a lodger, saving for last a scrawny white Pom whose pedigree rests entirely on love.

story.title: The Hat He Sat On
story.blurb: He ruins her cheap hat on purpose, buys her a beautiful one, and then asks a question she believes she has no right to answer.
story.spoilerNote: Reveals that the novelist Tanqueray courts and proposes marriage to the servant Rose, a turn the novel stages as a surprise to his circle.

short.title: Gringalet Pleads His Case
short.blurb: A greyhound raised from a bottle by his master's devoted servant invites himself along on an expedition, pleading with ears, paw, and beseeching eyes.

26482.pairNote: Separate episodes, though the longer one shows the lover the girl trusts in the shorter turned captor.

short.title: The Listener in the Leaves
short.blurb: Troubled by a forced suitor and a harsh stepfather, a girl climbs to her childhood refuge to think, and the wrong men stop beneath her branch.

story.title: Standoff at the Door
story.blurb: Dressed to walk out forever, she finds the doorway blocked by a smiling man certain that no little empress can defy him.
story.brokenNote: Stops mid sentence at the climactic grapple, leaving the final action hanging.

short.title: Psalms and Scythes
short.blurb: Fifty men come down a mountain at night, singing a psalm, carrying scythes and hatchets, to demand prisoners a militia will not release.

26563.pairNote: Two distinct demonstrations of Brande's powers with no shared text or shared payoff.

short.title: A Message from Brande
short.blurb: He knows who sent the telegram before he opens it. What he cannot explain is what becomes of it afterward.
short.spoilerNote: Reveals the reach of Brande's telepathic power, which the novel discloses step by step.

story.title: A Drop of Water
story.blurb: On a dark sea, a host promises his guests a scientific amusement: he will unmake a single drop of water and let them watch.
story.spoilerNote: Shows the annihilating power of Brande's science, which the novel builds toward gradually.

story.title: Into the Beggar King's Swamp
story.blurb: A detective in hobo disguise is warned that men who fail inspection never leave the swamp. Then the blindfold goes on.
story.spoilerNote: Plants the strong suspicion that the outlaw chief Hobo Harry is a woman, the identity mystery at the heart of the novel.

story.title: Ridden Down
story.blurb: A horseman answers an insult by riding a man into the dust before a shocked girl. The beaten man's apology hides a plan.

short.title: Twelve Children on a Warship
short.blurb: On an old anchored warship, a grizzled father raises twelve children, one of whom insists, quite calmly, that he can swim to shore.

story.title: A Question in the Park
story.blurb: In a holiday crowd, a shy suitor keeps losing his nerve until a chance meeting with a frail girl in a mystery wheelchair speaks for him.
story.spoilerNote: Reveals that Millard's courtship of Phillida ends in an engagement, a development the novel stages.

27365.pairNote: Drawn from two different tales in the collection, with no shared text and separate payoffs.

short.title: The Master Mathematician
short.blurb: His calculations finished after four sleepless nights, a mathematician looks from his window at a strange new star and decides what to tell his students at noon.

story.title: The First of All Axes
story.blurb: Dawn creeps over a chalk cliff where two sleepers camp on a narrow ledge. Something huge is climbing down the gully toward them, and the fire is ash.

short.title: The Bell in the Chimney
short.blurb: In a pitch dark cell, a young prisoner wakes to a small bell ringing from nowhere, then taps beneath the floor, then a string swinging at his window.
short.spoilerNote: Reveals that the hero Gaston is eventually imprisoned in the Bastille, a later turn in the novel.

27385.pairNote: The duel and the recruitment are separate early scenes with no shared text, and each keeps its own payoff.

short.title: The Masked Princess
short.blurb: In a hidden palace, a masked lady tells a young chevalier she is a persecuted princess seeking a champion. He pledges his sword half in jest.
short.spoilerNote: Gives away the staged unmasking of the conspiracy's patron as the Duchesse de Maine.

story.title: The Captain's Lesson
story.blurb: Six gentlemen walk into a quiet glade to settle affairs of honor, and an old campaigner turns his duel with a furious boy into a fencing lesson.

short.title: Farewell at Fraunces Tavern
short.blurb: A victorious general embraces his weeping officers at a tavern by the ferry, settles his accounts to the penny, and asks leave to become a private citizen.

story.title: The Silent Target
story.blurb: Outside a frontier dance, a lone watcher quietly turns troublemakers away so the music never stops, and pays a price nobody inside ever notices.

story.title: The Wrestling Crown
story.blurb: Twenty thousand hold their breath as an Athenian and a furious Spartan meet for the final wrestling of the games, two casts out of three for the crown.

short.title: A City Begs Its King
short.blurb: A king steps out to find his whole city kneeling at his altars, wreathed and wailing, while a priest gives voice to a land wasted by plague.

story.title: A Night in the Castle
story.blurb: Two travelers land at dawn in Finland, set on sleeping in a ruined island castle, whatever the bats, the owls, and the Mayor may say.

short.title: Terms of Surrender
short.blurb: A knight delivers his commander's terms to a besieged lady, who tears them to pieces and dashes them in his face. What he admits next softens her.
short.brokenNote: The text stops partway through the lady's closing sentence, cutting off the scene's final beat.

short.title: The Voice Over Her Shoulder
short.blurb: Alone in her grand hotel suite, a princess hears something move, checks every room, finds nothing, and settles into her bath. Then a voice speaks at her ear.
short.brokenNote: The passage stops mid-sentence just as the intruder's voice begins, so the scene has no ending.

short.title: Pennies for the Monkey
short.blurb: On a seaside honeymoon a bride kisses the dog, laughs at the monkey, and delights in everything except her new husband, who wants to know why.

short.title: The Parable of the Onion
short.blurb: A woman retells a folk tale her cook taught her: a wicked soul in a lake of fire, an angel, and one small onion held out in hope.

story.title: The Night Climb
story.blurb: Three men slip a skiff into a moonlit Kent cove in 1656. Their fierce leader knows a hidden way up the sheer cliff, and takes it.

short.title: The Buried Hat
short.blurb: A boy hauling iron ore forgets, for one moment, that thirsty oxen and a high bridge make a dangerous pair. His hat pays the price.

28203.pairNote: Two separate outings with the same pair, one playful and one perilous; neither steals the other's payoff.

short.title: Making Him Talk
short.blurb: Determined to crack a silent companion, a lively girl peppers him with questions while he weaves a birch basket. His answers are shorter than her patience.

story.title: Into the Burning Wood
story.blurb: Told the forest fire is too far to visit, a wilful girl marches straight toward it. The flames are grander and hungrier than she bargained for.

short.title: The Nantucket Pudding
short.blurb: A guest who has already dined is pressed to try his hostess's prized pudding. Politeness demands one plate; hospitality has other plans.

story.title: Followed Through the Ruins
story.blurb: A foreign traveler misses his turn at midnight in Moscow and strays into a quarter where a giant figure begins to follow. He speaks no Russian, and he is unarmed.

story.title: Why Should I Be Fought For
story.blurb: A husband appears at the terrace window while his wife stands with her lover. As a storm gathers outside, three people try to decide what happens next.
story.spoilerNote: Reveals that the wife's affair with the narrator exists and is discovered by her husband, a central turn of the novel.

story.title: Honest, Just a Joke
story.blurb: Two gunmen pick the wrong taxi to hold up. One passenger has a very large revolver, and the cabbie has a colorful past of his own.

story.title: The Scissors Duel
story.blurb: In a prison yard a mocked soldier answers an insult to a young girl's name with a quiet promise. That night, two scissor blades settle it.

31257.pairNote: The journey scheme and the first night ghost legend are separate scenes with no shared text or shared payoff.

short.title: The Monk's Cough
short.blurb: Alone for her first night in a strange grand house, a girl hears coughing from a room the maid swears is empty, and learns the legend behind it.

story.title: Left Behind
story.blurb: Two jealous cousins slip away by night to strand their prettier cousin at home, certain she is too timid to travel alone. Then a stranger knocks.

story.title: The Sleeper's Many Faces
story.blurb: Deep in a rotting damp house, a young man keeps the night watch while his sleeping uncle drifts into dreams that do not seem to be his own.
story.spoilerNote: The dream of a choking, possessing presence hints at the danger that later closes over the sleeping uncle in the full story.

story.title: The Secret Benefactor
story.blurb: A breezy American walks into a shabby weekly's office with an odd proposition: send a young writer to Switzerland in style, and never tell her who paid.

story.title: Bound in the Stolen Ship
story.blurb: A pilot wakes tied hand and foot aboard his own stolen spacecraft, while the terrified thief at the controls flees glowing serpents that strip ships bare.

story.title: The Apples of Derketa
story.blurb: Treed on a crag by a monster no blade can pierce, a barbarian lashes three sticks, a dagger, and poisoned fruit into one last weapon.

story.title: A High Pink Finish
story.blurb: At a hotel manicure table, a big spender in diamonds lays on the flattery while a sharp young manicurist files, parries, and weighs his dinner invitation.

story.title: The Building With No Door
story.blurb: In a lonely valley, a father and son blast their way into a sealed, humming building that has been doing something strange to the sunlight.

story.title: The Story of the Humpback
story.blurb: A merry humpback chokes at a tailor's supper, and his corpse begins a midnight journey from house to house as each new host panics.
story.brokenNote: It opens and closes mid-sentence, ending on a clipped word with the chain of blame still hanging unresolved.

story.title: The Question at Free Trade Hall
story.blurb: Two young women bring one small banner and one question to a packed political meeting, and refuse to sit down until somebody answers it.

story.title: The Girl on the Embankment
story.blurb: Walking home late along a canal, a hopelessly shy dreamer hears a stranger crying at the railing, and chance hands him his first real conversation with a woman.

story.title: The Sword in the Stone
story.blurb: England has no king, and a sword no lord can budge stands in a churchyard stone. A boy rides back for his brother's forgotten blade.

story.title: The Banished Magdalene
story.blurb: A village that stages the Passion has cast out its finest player. On a stormy night she walks the weir plank, and a stranger watches from the shore.

short.title: Behind the Curtain
short.blurb: At a dance, a girl who hates parties backs into a curtained nook already occupied by a shy boy from next door.
short.brokenNote: The final line stops mid sentence, so the reader hits a visible truncation instead of an ending.

story.title: Anger on Thin Ice
story.blurb: Amy burns the little book her sister spent years writing. Jo vows never to forgive her, while the last ice of winter waits on the river.

short.title: An Hour After Midnight
short.blurb: It is an hour after midnight; a letter has just told a general that his friend is dead. He writes through grief to the one soul that steadies him.

short.title: Two Minutes for Panting
short.blurb: At a fashionable spa, the whole town's morning is ruled by one very small man with a monocle, a physician with an enormous watch, and perfect timing.

story.title: Lilacs at Sunrise
story.blurb: A guest slips out at dawn to bid goodbye to a borrowed paradise and to the woman who belongs in it. Then a window opens above him.

short.title: The Doctor's Scar
short.blurb: A country doctor carries a long scar down his jaw. The story behind it begins with a slip on a rug in a room full of surgical instruments.

story.title: The Singing House
story.blurb: Lost on a winter night and unable to recall her friend's name, a girl hears a voice singing inside a dark and empty house.

short.title: Out of the Wreckage
short.blurb: A man wakes in the night forest beside a burning plane, with a lump on his head and no memory beyond one blinding flash of light.

story.title: The Pirates' Chorus
story.blurb: Two travelers reach a lonely moorland inn where a room full of young gentlemen sings pirate songs. One listener knows exactly what the singing means.
story.spoilerNote: Shows that Major Helzephron commands the pirate gang, an identity the novel spends its early chapters building toward.

short.title: The Grandfather of All Parrots
short.blurb: Two wanderers on a silent shore meet an ancient parrot that fixes them with knowing eyes, then shrieks words in a tongue no living person can name.

short.title: The Bolted Door
short.blurb: A traveler wakes in the dark to the door he bolted swinging open, and something enormous with a misshapen head slipping quietly inside.
short.spoilerNote: Shows the night attack that the book builds toward as a creeping suspicion about what happens to guests of a treacherous host.

short.title: The Goddess Wakes
short.blurb: In a lost palace a thief stands over a woman dead for a thousand years. Then color touches her cheeks and her lashes begin to lift.

story.title: The Haunter of the Pits
story.blurb: Handed a dagger by a stranger, a prisoner steps out of his cell into a vast darkness where something huge and silent is smelling out his trail.
story.spoilerNote: Reveals that the hero is imprisoned partway through the book and escapes the dungeon with a smuggled dagger.

story.title: The Hillman's Parley
story.blurb: A governor holding seven tribesmen hostage summons their chieftain to parley. The man arrives through the window, knife first, and the night takes a wilder turn.
story.spoilerNote: Gives away the queen's incognito visit to the frontier fort and her abduction, the book's early pivotal turn.

short.title: He May Yet Be Saved
short.blurb: A storm hurls a great ship against a cliff and grinds it to splinters. Then a watching boy spots one man still alive among the waves.

short.title: The Face at the Window
short.blurb: On a grey afternoon a woman steps into the dining room and finds a familiar face at the window, close to the glass, staring straight in.
short.spoilerNote: Reveals the apparition's return and the narrator's certainty that it has come for someone else, an early key development of the book.

story.title: The Crash in Chelsea
story.blurb: An aeroplane falls out of a May morning and a tangled parachute lands on a studio roof. Neighbors, painters and police scramble, but one man never comes upstairs.

43936.pairNote: Two separate episodes from different stretches of the same journey, with no shared text and no repeated payoff.

short.title: The Cowardly Lion
short.blurb: A great lion bounds into the road and bowls over her friends, until a small girl slaps his nose and hears a very surprising confession.

story.title: The Kalidahs
story.blurb: A gulf too wide to leap blocks the forest road, then a second, then two beasts with bodies like bears and heads like tigers close in.

short.title: The Poisoned Dish
short.blurb: An emperor takes a few mouthfuls at dinner, feels his heart rise, and grows suspicious. The cooks go under guard while a dog tells the truth.

short.title: My Beloved Violin
short.blurb: Locked in years of bondage, a man tells what one violin gave him: friends, rest, comfort at midnight, and the wildest dancing in Louisiana starlight.

47221.pairNote: Different characters and different nights; neither scene touches the other's payoff.

short.title: The Niece of Cinna
short.blurb: Surrounded on a dark Roman road by three swaggering men of rank, a young woman has only her name, her nerve, and one loyal slave beside her.

story.title: A Summons by Moonlight
story.blurb: A secret note calls a young Roman to a moonlit temple where a veiled woman waits. She offers him everything; he wants only to see her face.
story.spoilerNote: Reveals who the veiled woman at the temple is and that she becomes the hero's secret enemy, a discovery the book stages through the mysterious summons.

story.title: First Night at the Wheel
story.blurb: His pilot falls sick, the raftsmen want Stillwater tonight, and a boy of nineteen takes the wheel just as lightning rolls down the lake.

story.title: The Balcony Scene
story.blurb: Hidden in a dark orchard, a young man hears the girl above confess her love to the night air. He answers, though being found means death.

short.title: The Robbler's Feather
short.blurb: On a Tyrol mountain path, a feather worn the wrong way in a hat means a challenge to fight. A girl hurries to explain before fists fly.

48320.pairNote: Two entirely separate cases with no shared text or shared reveals.

short.title: The Battered Hat
short.blurb: Two men examine a shabby black hat a stranger left behind. One sees nothing; the other reads the owner's whole fortunes from its brim.

story.title: The Bar of Gold
story.blurb: A doctor is pulled from his fireside to fetch a friend home from an opium den by the docks. Among the smoke, an old man plucks his sleeve.

short.title: Two Horses in Step
short.blurb: Two riders pace down an avenue of elms at sunset, horses perfectly in step, neither speaking. He will call it the one moment he truly lived.

story.title: The Man in Lincoln Green
story.blurb: A lord's kinsman spoils a village May dance and calls for a farmer's ears. Then a stranger in green leaps from the inn window, staff in hand.

50133.pairNote: Separate episodes; the story span notes in passing a death that follows the short's scene, but neither contains the other's payoff.

short.title: The Forbidden Loan
short.blurb: A librarian looks up at a bent, goatish giant asking to borrow a dreadful old book, and weighs what refusing such a visitor might cost.
short.spoilerNote: States outright that the visitor is barely human and hints his mother met a dark end, points the book unveils gradually.

story.title: The Prints in the Road
story.blurb: Dogs bark all night in a hill country village. By morning there are round prints in the road, big as barrel heads, and the party line hums with panic.
story.spoilerNote: Mentions in passing that Wilbur has died and that something was reared in the sealed house, developments the book stages before this point.

short.title: The Runaway Freighter
short.blurb: From a station promenade, watchers follow a doomed freighter circling Earth like a runaway moon, waiting for the flare that will end it.

story.title: Escape in a Silk Gown
story.blurb: Bailiffs search the house for a debt-dodging captain, who slips downstairs in his landlady's silk gown and veil. Staying free will take nerve, cheek, and one good punch.

short.title: Ambush on the Platform
short.blurb: A man waits alone for a shuttle train, one hand never leaving his coat pocket. Two strangers creep out of the woods behind him with a revolver.

53419.pairNote: Two unrelated tales from the same collection, with different settings and payoffs.

short.title: Chair Number Thirteen
short.blurb: Aboard a night train, a traveler keeps glimpsing someone in chair thirteen, though the seat is plainly empty. Then a helpful voice speaks up behind her.

story.title: The Toe in the Moonlight
story.blurb: A traveler in a lockless room at a Dutch inn wakes at midnight to see a single bare human toe standing in a strip of moonlight.

story.title: Adrift Below the Cliffs
story.blurb: A stolen hour below the sea cliffs goes wrong: the lady cannot climb back, dusk is falling, fog is rolling in, and one small boat is their only chance.

short.title: The Major and the Tiger
short.blurb: Brought to bay, a tiger throws himself on his back, claws out, as hunters fire from their elephant. Then the twenty-two-stone major loses his balance.

short.title: The Court Depressor
short.blurb: Deep underground, a traveler and his dog meet a small solemn man whose hand glows clear as amber, and who sorrowfully bids them welcome to his land.

story.title: The Thinking Machine's Wager
story.blurb: A frail professor insists mind is master of all things, and wagers he can escape a prison death-cell within a week, asking only tooth powder, cash, and a shoeshine.

story.title: The Boy in the Cherry Tree
story.blurb: A princess who knows only her birds and butterflies chases a strange purple butterfly to the palace wall, where a laughing boy pelts her with ripe cherries.

57821.pairNote: Two separate true episodes from the same life, one inward and quiet, one a public street rescue.

short.title: The Changed Prayer
short.blurb: Through the long nights an enslaved woman prays for her master's heart to change, while he brings buyers to look at her. In March, her prayer changes.

story.title: The Rescue of Charles Nalle
story.blurb: Word races through Troy that a fugitive has been seized and will be sent south. One woman pushes through the crowd to the commissioner's door and stands her ground.

58866.pairNote: The longer span alludes back to the breakfast conversation but shares no text with it, and their payoffs are entirely different.

short.title: A Question of Symmetry
short.blurb: Over breakfast, a fastidious little man lectures his friend on sea sickness, nervous ladies, and the moral failings of an asymmetrical piece of toast.

story.title: The Road to Merlinville
story.blurb: A detective and his friend cross to France in high spirits, trading banter about fox hunts and footprints, summoned by a millionaire's plea for protection.
story.spoilerNote: Reveals that the client is found murdered on arrival, the inciting shock at the end of the novel's opening chapters.

story.title: The Suspicious Major
story.blurb: Travelers land on a coast plagued by pirates and meet a planter leaning on a monstrous rifle. Breakfast or a bullet depends on what he decides they are.

59827.pairNote: Two unrelated episodes, a boyhood crisis of faith and the great fire, that coexist without touching.

short.title: Who Made God?
short.blurb: A boy certain of scripture meets one question he cannot answer. Within an hour his whole spiritual world lies in ruins, and something unexpected rises in its place.

story.title: The Night Chicago Burned
story.blurb: A city burns to the waterline while thousands camp on the lakeshore. One young drover races to save a herd of cattle and discovers what people are made of.

story.title: The Dog at the Door
story.blurb: A sailor fresh from an Indian voyage stops for a shave on Fleet Street. His dog takes one look at the barber and refuses to leave the door.

short.title: The Square Cop
short.blurb: A policeman swears he is on the square. The Commissioner tests him with a sneer, then hands him orders that no honest man could stomach.

story.title: Playing the Game

story.spoilerNote: Reveals that Aliette admits an attachment and that her husband refuses her a divorce, a central mid-book turning point.

story.title: An Ear for an Ear
story.blurb: A king pardons the stray arrow that takes his ear. Then shipwreck, murder, and a stranger's blood on his clothes leave his life hanging on one lucky throw.

story.title: Take Away That Bauble

61168.pairNote: The diary sketch and the dressing room scene share no text, characters, or reveals.

short.title: I Hate Being Involved

story.title: The Dancer's Whip Hand
story.blurb: After her triumph, a dancer receives an elegant visitor and confides her plan: she alone holds the whip hand over the mastermind they both serve.

short.title: Deduce, Poirot!
short.blurb: From a window over a London street, one friend spins a drama of crooks and shadowers below. The other simply rises to look for himself.

short.title: Going Back to Grandma
short.blurb: Three years old and done with it all, a small girl announces she is leaving home for Grandma's. Between her and the way stands a black embankment.

64317.pairNote: Two separate scenes from different evenings; no shared text and neither contains the other's payoff.

short.title: A Room Full of Wind
short.blurb: A visitor steps into a bright, breezy room where curtains stream like flags and two young women in white seem to float above an enormous couch.

story.title: Looking for the Host
story.blurb: At a glittering summer party, a guest wanders from bar to library hunting for the host nobody has met, and no one can say who he really is.
story.spoilerNote: Gives away the charming surprise of how the mysterious host first introduces himself, an early staged moment in the novel.

story.title: A Caller in the Study
story.blurb: A poised young widow receives a foreign stranger who produces a compromising letter signed with her name. Her reaction is not at all what he planned for.

short.title: Under the Seat

short.brokenNote: The text visibly cuts off mid-sentence at the very end ('the imperative jerking of the'), so the final line reads as a glitch rather than a close.

story.title: The Wrong Sort of Bees
story.blurb: A bear with a taste for honey borrows a blue balloon, disguises himself as a small black cloud, and floats up beside a bee tree. The bees grow suspicious.

story.title: Her Uncle's Wager
story.blurb: A strange will gives a clever young woman one year to outwit her dead uncle and find what he hid at the manor. She brings the puzzle to a specialist.

story.title: A Voice in the Darkness
story.blurb: In the dark of a cold night, a disguised English captain hears a commanding Spanish voice and decides to escort its owner straight into an enemy city.
story.brokenNote: The passage stops mid-sentence in the middle of a muttered vow ('for my queen—if'), leaving the final line hanging.

67979.pairNote: Both stretches come from the same family dinner but share no text, and each lands its own distinct punchline.

short.title: The Greatest Happiness
short.blurb: At a stiff family dinner, the quiet cousin everyone ignores suddenly says exactly what she thinks. Nobody knows what to do about it.

story.title: In Defense of Barney Snaith
story.blurb: Her relatives trade lurid rumors about a mysterious recluse until the family's quietest woman starts demanding proof, and then stops holding her tongue altogether.

story.title: The Cult in the Swamp
story.blurb: New Orleans police follow drumbeats into night-black cypress woods that terrified locals refuse to enter, toward a red glare and a chant no human throat should utter.
story.spoilerNote: Reveals the cult, its chant, and the carven idol that the full story unveils as step-by-step discoveries, though not its final horror.

short.title: The Marrow Over the Wall
short.blurb: A man weeding his garden is nearly struck by a vegetable marrow flung over the wall. The neighbor's apology is stranger than the assault.

69700.pairNote: The two passages open entirely different cases in the collection and share nothing.

short.title: The Science of Observation
short.blurb: A sunburned stranger takes the visitor's chair, and his silent host names his war, his regiment, and his trade before he can begin his story.

story.title: The Count and the Waxwork
story.blurb: A jewel thief creeps into an empty room to strike down his enemy, only to find a wax figure in the chair and the real man watching.
story.spoilerNote: Shows the wax decoy and the detective's disguises that this particular case's closing trick is built on.

short.title: Snails and Suspicions
short.blurb: Over snails and oysters, two friends weigh whether suspicion is ever a duty, until the doctor at the next table breaks in with a grievance of his own.

70175.pairNote: The confession frame and the garden murder come from different parts of the book and share no text or payoff.

short.title: The Priest's Confession
short.blurb: Pressed at last to explain how he untangles murders, a small quiet priest gives an answer that lifts his questioner clean out of his chair.
short.spoilerNote: Gives away the titular 'secret' of the priest's method, which the book's frame story stages as its own reveal.

story.title: Shots in the Judge's Garden
story.blurb: On a midnight ramble, a detective and his friend hear two revolver shots from a judge's strangely illuminated garden and go over the wall.

story.title: The City in the Ice
story.blurb: Two explorers in a small aeroplane climb toward an untrodden polar pass, where the wind pipes weirdly through cave mouths, and look on what no human eye has seen.
story.spoilerNote: Reveals that the mirage city beyond the mountains is real, one of the book's staged discoveries, though none of its deeper horrors.

short.title: A Hard Man's Daughter
short.blurb: A millionaire confronts the son-in-law who ruined his daughter's marriage, and hears a colder account of that marriage than he bargained for.

75201.pairNote: A first meeting and a wounding, far apart in the book, with no shared text and neither spoiling the other.

short.title: Close to the Front
short.blurb: On a garden bench near the front, a soldier admires a nurse's hair, and she tells him, without tears, exactly what the war has already taken from her.

story.title: The Dugout
story.blurb: In a shallow dugout, ambulance drivers share macaroni, cheese, and sour wine while the shelling walks closer with every cough of the guns.

75288.pairNote: Comic banter at the house and a death on the road; separate scenes in different registers.

short.title: They Needn't Die in My House
short.blurb: A gentle peer, newly restored to his ancestral acres, complains about steam-roller personalities, depressing virtues, and the sheer inconsiderateness of people dying in his house.

story.title: The Man in the Road
story.blurb: A fast car, a man reeling out of the hedge, a dying message she cannot understand: then the doctor comes back from his surgery looking grim.
story.spoilerNote: Reveals an early death and the dying message that launches the book's plot, though none of its later secrets.

story.title: Tea with Mr. Gilder
story.blurb: Her brother invents an errand and vanishes, leaving her alone in a gray-eyed stranger's library, where the hospitality turns out to have a purpose.
story.spoilerNote: Hints that the heroine's heart turns toward Dick rather than her fiance, and that her brother is in Gilder's power, early developments rather than final reveals.

75790.pairNote: The guitar visitor and the fireside tale are separate episodes with no shared text.

short.title: The Man with the Guitar
short.blurb: A merry Italian stranger fills the kitchen with song and chatter, until the narrator's father holds out his hand for the guitar he has itched to play for years.

story.title: A Tapping at the Window
story.blurb: Safe by the fire in a lonely hut, a boy listens to his father's tale of buried gold and dead men, until something taps at the window.

75808.pairNote: Two separate capers by the same thief; each carries its own payoff.

short.title: Ten Thousand Pounds
short.blurb: A hospital doctor, desperate for funds, takes a telephone call from a young woman who claims she has already sent him ten thousand pounds, after a fashion.

story.title: The Midnight Ambulance
story.blurb: While a great house sleeps, a slim figure slips from bedroom to bedroom among the guests' jewels, and an ambulance idles at the door below.

75840.pairNote: The double's unveiling and the night crime are different scenes; neither gives away the other's punch.

short.title: Another Man's Face
short.blurb: An old woman holds up the candle and looks from one young man to the other: the same face twice, and only one of them owns it.
short.spoilerNote: Reveals that the villainous usher has an exact double, machinery the book later puts to use.

story.title: Making a Swing
story.blurb: At midnight a schoolmaster knots three ropes together and climbs from his window, telling the feverish boy in his care that he is making a swing.

short.title: A Pigeon for the Plucking
short.blurb: An inspector arrives with a new case, and the private detective he consults cannot stop laughing at him. The trouble concerns a very worthy parish priest.
short.spoilerNote: It gives away the running joke that the detective profits from every case the inspector brings him, which the book first springs as a surprise.

story.title: Nothing Was Stolen
story.blurb: A baroness hires a detective who works for free. He asks one question about her locked boudoir, then invites her to look closer at what the thief left behind.
story.spoilerNote: It reveals that the necklace was secretly swapped for paste, the discovery this episode of the book builds toward.

story.title: Trespassing, Fifty Dollars
story.blurb: Three ladies drive their automobile through a rotten bridge, and the woman who owns it names her price for everything: trespassing, timber, even water.

short.title: The Black Thread
short.blurb: An odd, solemn man crawls up a dark staircase on his knees, striking at the empty air with his stick, while a young constable watches from below.

story.title: A Malicious Man
story.blurb: A flashy man with jewelled rings waits at Waterloo Station for a girl who wants nothing to do with him. Then someone takes his arm.

story.title: The Guest Holds the Bank
story.blurb: At a private club, a courteous elderly guest holds the bank while a steady player loses and loses, feeling his own thoughts slip out of his grip.

story.title: Lights Out in the Library
story.blurb: A girl kills the lights as a gunman slips into the library, then moves along the wall in blackness while he hunts her by sound and flash.

short.title: You May Call It a Dog
short.blurb: Called to a sleepless, ragged patient, a doctor finds a sleeve torn away in one rip and wounds the man will only half explain.

story.title: The Cloak Drawn to Her Chin
story.blurb: Summoned at night to a strange house, a doctor finds a bruised door, a silent weeping man, and a pale patient who answers no questions.

short.title: The Altar on the Mountain
short.blurb: A man remembers the mountain that filled his first nightmares, the ring of standing stones he found near its summit, and the promise a doctor made him give.

story.title: The Visitor in Yellow Boots
story.blurb: On his daughter's wedding day, a prosperous man receives a shabby visitor just out of prison, who believes he is owed forty thousand pounds.
story.spoilerNote: The visitor's talk of his own boy and the daughter's wedding day hints at the revenge scheme the book soon unmasks.

short.title: Standing in a Hole
short.blurb: Laura plans to endure a blind date, not enjoy it. Then her date looks up at her, asks if she is standing in a hole, and ruins her gloom.

76200.pairNote: The story restates the short's whole punch, that the waiter has drugged the members into a reversible lethargy, so reading it first defuses the short's apparent deaths.

short.title: The Sleeping Jury
short.blurb: At the Clue Club, a judge watches the members around him slump into slumber, one by one, while the waiter calmly explains that this is not a mock trial.
short.brokenNote: The text is cut off mid-sentence at the end ('or sprawled on the').

story.title: Trial by Candlelight
story.blurb: On Christmas Eve, by candlelight, a strange waiter puts a hanging judge on trial for the sentence of death, with the club's sleeping members as the stakes.

short.title: Pearls in the Lining
short.blurb: Lady Moya's pearls have vanished from a locked dressing-room. Michael bets they never left it, and asks to see her wardrobe.

short.title: The Red Lady of Toulouse
short.blurb: An executioner and his crew celebrate too well the night before a morning's work in Toulouse. At three o'clock, the 'red lady' still waits to be assembled.

short.title: The Thing by the Ruined Mill
short.blurb: A rider takes a dark November road home. At the ruined mill his mare wheels in terror, and something cold and clammy strikes him in the face.

short.title: The Missing Ticket Stub
short.blurb: Caught slipping out of a theatre, a small-time crook swears he bought a ticket, if only he could find the stub. The Inspector waits, unimpressed.

story.title: The Screaming Forest
story.blurb: On an opal road between bright-green globes, a running figure is snatched by something that screams in triumph. The stranger watching from a cave has an axe.

short.title: The Dragon in the Cave
short.blurb: Peter calls three times at the cave mouth, sword thrust out, certain nothing will answer. Then comes a deep, deep sigh, and yards of bright green.

story.title: The Dragon at the Window
story.blurb: Tap, tap, tap at the nursery window: the dragon is back, warm as a stove, with room on his back for three children and more.

short.title: Two Burglars, One Safe
short.blurb: A burglar switches on his pocket light and finds another man already at the safe, masked, armed, and equally unwilling to introduce himself.

short.title: Dreams from the Sea
short.blurb: Each night Dean's dream grows: the green, shining place under the sea comes clearer, and the swimming shadows draw closer. His doctor writes a prescription for nerves.

story.title: The Kiss in the Cave
story.blurb: A cable from a far-travelling uncle warns Dean to leave the house above the sea at once. Instead he watches the moon rise, and sleeps, and dreams.
story.spoilerNote: Depicts the kiss that sets the book's possession plot in motion, hinting at what is invading Dean before the book explains it.

short.title: Stand and Deliver
short.blurb: Two robbers stop a big, cheerful traveller on a forest road and demand his wallet. Simon has a cudgel, solid brawn, and nothing worth stealing but onions.

story.title: Help, Ye Forest Powers
story.blurb: A furious wood-nymph drags a lazy misanthrope on a headlong midnight run to a forest clearing, where a lone youth holds off a ring of robbers.

story.title: The Man Called Brown
story.blurb: A self-satisfied spy creeps up a dark hillside to eavesdrop on a mysterious wireless operator, and hears rather more about his colleague's loyalty than he bargained for.

short.title: Flight from the Crystal Baths
short.blurb: An earthquake splits a vast crystal bathhouse, and a winged islander straps a wingless visitor to her back for a desperate flight through the collapsing roof.
short.brokenNote: The final sentence is cut off mid-clause, ending on the words "as it leapt over the".

76541.pairNote: The two scenes come from different cases in the same collection and share no text or payoff.

short.title: A Shot in the Dark Street
short.blurb: Two drunk friends weave down a dark street of little shops until a silent stranger blocks their path. What happens next takes seconds, and lands on the wrong man.

story.title: The Body in the Snow
story.blurb: A lawyer is flagged down on a frozen road where an old client lies dead in the snow. Then a mild stranger with a furled umbrella steps from the dark.

story.title: The Coolest Lady Afloat
story.blurb: A gallant artist hurls himself into the surf to save a lady drifting out to sea, only to find her provokingly unbothered by her own rescue.

short.title: Whom He Loves Best
short.blurb: A butler crosses himself as he announces the visitor. Alone in the sunny drawing room, the caller lays out a scrap of red silk and a card bearing a curse.

story.title: The Memorandum Book
story.blurb: On a silent winter street, an assailant demands a memorandum book from a frail old man who knows too much. A young journalist's footsteps arrive a moment late.

76668.pairNote: The story span contains the short span's entire rapids run word for word.

short.title: Shooting the Rapids
short.blurb: A quiet bushman stands up in his canoe, reads the raging water ahead, and drives his frail craft straight into the torrent with a plan behind his eyes.

story.title: The Place of the Testing
story.blurb: A quiet trapper watches his wife watching the handsome guest in the bow of the canoe. Ahead, the rapids roar, and he has chosen them for a reason.

story.title: Twenty Thousand Pounds
story.blurb: A poised young woman from the police calls on a titled lady with one quiet question: why did twenty thousand pounds leave her bank on Monday?

story.title: The Marriage Bargain
story.blurb: At midnight, a young woman calls on the elderly man who holds her father's ruin in his hands, and negotiates the terms of her own marriage.
story.brokenNote: The closing sentence is truncated mid-clause, ending on "anxious to get home before".

short.title: Run Along, Little Man
short.blurb: Among ghosts at cards, a hopelessly small leader is deputed to eject a giant professional gambler from the presence of ladies preparing to learn poker.

76759.pairNote: Separate scenes with different characters; no shared text or shared payoff.

short.title: The Letter at Ten O'Clock
short.blurb: A letter of sad tidings arrives at ten o'clock. A woman who dare not be seen in daylight kisses the corner bed goodbye and slips into the night.

story.title: The Scuffle Next Door
story.blurb: Two boys leaning out a night window hear a policeman seize a prowler next door, and the whole household tumbles downstairs into a small, delicious mystery.

story.title: The Body in Millfield Lane
story.blurb: Walking home past midnight in the rain, a very new doctor finds a dead man lying across a lonely lane and goes to fetch the police.

story.title: Hoofs, Hoofs, Hoofs
story.blurb: A wounded Mountie and the killer holding his gun sit marooned on one boulder while a caribou migration thunders past, trading taunts to keep from going mad.
story.brokenNote: The text stops mid-sentence ('filled with clashing antlers and the'), so the standoff simply cuts off with no ending.

76849.pairNote: Village courtship and the alien summons are separate beats with no shared payoff.

short.title: Too Much Fish
short.blurb: A young hunter comes ashore with more fish than one man can eat, and the chief's sharp-tongued daughter stops by, carrying a message that could mean combat.

story.title: The Silver Egg
story.blurb: Against every instinct, a stone-age hunter walks east past sabre-tooth country, drawn by an urge he cannot fight toward a silver egg taller than the trees.
story.spoilerNote: Reveals what the silver ovoid is and the visitors' ecology experiment, the premise the full story builds its opening mystery around.

short.title: Hello, Barton
short.blurb: In an empty town, every phone rings for one old man. The voice on the line is young, tireless, and impossible to hang up on.
short.spoilerNote: Reveals that the caller is Barton's own younger recorded self, the central conceit the full story unfolds gradually.

76858.pairNote: The short's closing shock, 'I killed her,' is the very event the story span recounts in full, so reading either first flattens the other.

short.title: I See Her Night and Day
short.blurb: A year on, Jack is a wasted shadow of himself, flinching from something no one else can see. His friend gently coaxes out what happened.

story.title: The Mesmerist's Betrothed
story.blurb: A parlour mesmerist makes a boy play Mozart he never learned, and his betrothed begs to be put under too. He tells what came of giving in.

76871.pairNote: The bar sketch introduces the schemer whom the burglary scene later catches red-handed; complementary, not duplicated.

short.title: The Eminent Ex-Congressman
short.blurb: Peter Q. Hornswoggle, eminent ex-congressman, holds a barroom audience spellbound with tales of apple-parers and applause, until a newspaper item lights a gleam in his eye.

story.title: A Very Popular Safe
story.blurb: A chemist wakes to crashing glassware and finds two rival burglars brawling in his laboratory. Then a third walks in, and this one handles a revolver expertly.

story.title: Porky's Confession
story.blurb: Cheerful Porky Jenks arrives rumpled and haunted, begging his writer friend to believe the impossible: last week, sitting by his window, he became somebody else entirely.

short.title: Aunt Lona's Inspection
short.blurb: A young man enters his own house hat in hand and is met by a crochet-wielding aunt with the bearing of a drill sergeant.

short.title: Frozen to the Pane
short.blurb: Someone has peeped through the window on two nights running. On his way past the frosted pane, Renfro finds what the cold kept for him.

short.title: The Derelict Handbag
short.blurb: On a misty November night, two friends pass a locked church and find a handbag abandoned in the dark porch, forced open by hands unknown.

story.title: The Silent Passenger
story.blurb: A train stands at a junction platform with one passenger who will never wake. Two sharp-eyed doctors sift the compartment for small clues before the police arrive.

story.title: Thirty Thousand a Year
story.blurb: A private soldier learns he has inherited a vast fortune, and watches his own master weep with envy. The money cannot buy back what he truly misses.

short.title: The Glove and the Blue Ribbon
short.blurb: At a tournament before Charlemagne, a victorious young knight sees a tiny glove tied with blue ribbon fall at his feet, and looks up.

story.title: The Sorcerer and the Emperor
story.blurb: A sorcerer walks unseen through a sleeping army camp, relieving an emperor of his sword, his crown, and his dignity, then offers to lead the pursuit.

story.title: A Rope in the Lantern Light
story.blurb: A wallet vanishes from a wagon camp at midnight. When the crowd finds it in a red-headed stranger's bag, someone quietly suggests a rope.

story.title: A Visitor in a Thick Veil
story.blurb: A businessman returns to his office and hears a lady waited an hour for him yesterday. He turns white, for he knows why that cannot be.

short.title: Wake Up, I'm Here
short.blurb: Helen slips past the screen to wake Lord Abbotsford, asleep by the fire, his table laid out with banknotes, diamonds, and her only photograph.

story.title: Three Shots at Dawn
story.blurb: A cowhand rigs a dummy of himself beside a disputed spring and beds down in the brush. At first light, a rifle speaks three times.

short.title: The Parson Plays the Wheel
short.blurb: A minister walks into a crowded saloon to settle an unusual bargain: the gambler sat through his sermon, so tonight the parson takes his turn at the wheel.

short.title: Jonah and the Fox
short.blurb: A weary prophet shares his supper with a polite fox, who has one small theological question that the Schools never quite answered.

story.title: The Marriage Embassy
story.blurb: A proud mother and her tongue-tied brother call on a prince with an audacious request on behalf of her son, the prophet.
story.spoilerNote: Reveals in advance that the prince refuses Jonah's hoped-for marriage to the Lady Judith.

short.title: The O'Shea
short.blurb: A handsome stranger in white drill studies a document through a monocle, until an old soldier across the room recognizes him and jumps up.

77022.pairNote: A newsroom character sketch and a criminal's escape; no shared scenes, characters, or reveals.

short.title: The Reporter's Unruly Ears
short.blurb: A newsroom tyrant glares from his throne at Jimmy Price, a first rate reporter cursed with ears that wiggle on their own whenever excitement strikes.

story.title: One Last Cigarette
story.blurb: Handcuffed in a shabby room, a burglar learns murder now hangs over him. He begs for one cigarette, and his slow mind starts moving very fast.

77033.pairNote: Both circle the same Waverly Place address from opposite angles, but they share no text and neither hands over the other's payoff.

short.title: No Trout Today
short.blurb: A restless young detective daydreams of trout streams through a slow spring morning, until one short phone call snaps every fiber of him awake.

story.title: The Proposal in the Rain
story.blurb: In a rain washed midnight cab, Donald finally speaks his love. Mary trembles at her own doorstep, haunted by something she cannot bring herself to name.

short.title: Enter Moris Klaw
short.blurb: Into a hushed crime scene shuffles an ancient stranger in a caped cloak, spraying scent on his brow and announcing that he smells dead men.

story.title: The Danbazzar Papyrus
story.blurb: A dealer in smuggled antiquities spreads a stained papyrus before a rich collector and his son, promising secrets no living man has heard since the pharaohs.

story.title: The Duel by Torchlight
story.blurb: Torches ring a midnight field as two knights break lance after lance before the lady Gabrielle, one riding with grace, the other with fury.

story.title: Freia's Altar
story.blurb: A woodsman climbs to a forbidden pagan altar and meets a veiled figure claiming to be a goddess returned, with two iron knights at her call.

story.title: Among the Walking Trees
story.blurb: Stranded on a strange world, a traveler flees a bellowing bull and climbs the nearest tree, which slaps him down and files charges.

78004.pairNote: Two separate true episodes from different voyages, a castaway's rescue and a shipwreck ordeal, with no shared text or characters.

short.title: Finding Alexander Selkirk
short.blurb: Privateers anchoring at a lonely island find not a prize but a ragged Scot who has survived there alone for four years, hiding from every wrong flag.

story.title: Wreck of the Speedwell
story.blurb: A gale drives a ship onto the rocks. The survivors build a new vessel from her bones while discipline rots and the crew writes its own law.

story.title: The Knife Between His Teeth
story.blurb: Bound to a cot while a sinister surgeon prepares his instruments and sponge of ether, Cole has one knife within reach and only seconds to use it.

78011.pairNote: Consecutive beats of one escape; the story presumes the sawing happened but never restages the cat's secret, so each keeps its own punch.

short.title: The Cat in the Dark Cell
short.blurb: In the black punishment cells a prisoner strokes a visiting cat, praying the guard will not notice what his fingers have found under her fur.

story.title: Up From the Punishment Block
story.blurb: Out of a lightless punishment block a prisoner creeps toward the one locked door, meaning to free his broken comrades or die at the top of the stairs.

short.title: The Armada Chest
short.blurb: A vendor swears his old box is Armada treasure, kept in his family for generations. The woman examining it reads its true history with her fingertips.

story.title: The Voyage of the Tubs
story.blurb: A shipwrecked family sets out for an unknown shore in eight wooden tubs, with hens under planks, a bag of mysteries, and two dogs swimming behind.

story.title: The Girl on the Hillside
story.blurb: Boys chase a weeping stranger up a hillside orchard until a young man steps in. She has lived on the island a year, and nobody has ever seen her.

story.title: The Wrong Suitcase
story.blurb: In a curtained cafe booth, an overheard quarrel ends in gunfire and sudden darkness. A cowboy flees with a frightened stranger, a suitcase that is not his, and an idea.

story.title: The Hothouse Bouquet
story.blurb: Fenella brings her mother a gentleman's hothouse flowers, expecting delight. Instead the household erupts, and the child glimpses truths her mother never meant to show.

short.title: An English Word
short.blurb: In a guarded German town, an interned Englishman watches a young mother and her baby on their balcony, and risks a single forbidden sentence in passing.

78039.pairNote: Two separate episodes from one woman's story, a death in a grand house and a later venture among mill workers; neither gives away the other's turn.

short.title: No Tears for Josiah
short.blurb: A parlor maid finds the master of the house still at his desk in his dinner coat. Upstairs, his widow discovers she cannot feel what she should.

story.title: The Boarder on Suosso's Lane
story.blurb: A little old lady in a worn shawl climbs off the bus at a rope works, asking for a job in an accent that is not her own.

story.title: Pirates of the Sound
story.blurb: On calm water, a honeymoon canoe draws the notice of a great war canoe with sixteen paddlers. A parley buys minutes; a steady rifle must buy the rest.
story.spoilerNote: It shows Kate already married to Isaac Pelton, settling the courtship question the romance builds toward.

story.title: Bab Improves His Mind
story.blurb: Studying above the library door, a girl overhears schoolmates gleefully mocking someone below, and every teasing word seems aimed straight at her own tender spot.

short.title: The Voice in the Hedge
short.blurb: A whisper slips through the garden hedge: the fair is on at Oakfield, there is a real live elephant, and mother need never know.

short.title: Telling His Father
short.blurb: A young man leans across the table and tries to tell his father about the woman who makes him hold his breath. His father listens, then reaches over.

story.title: The Long Walk Uptown
story.blurb: Down to one pipeful of tobacco and a humiliating offer, a hungry man drinks a neighbor's coffee, dreams over blueprints, then walks uptown into the snow.

short.title: The Brides of Venice
short.blurb: Pirates burst into a Venetian wedding and carry off the brides, dowry chests and all. The Doge girds on his sword and the bridegrooms give chase.

short.title: Them Huggins Boys
short.blurb: A newcomer to the Sandhills keeps hearing ill of two notorious brothers, and a station agent's tangled warning only deepens the mystery.

short.title: Married This Afternoon
short.blurb: She agrees to fly to Callisto with him only after a provisional marriage, and he grins and tells her the paperwork was signed that afternoon.

story.title: Headache Satellite
story.blurb: A couple lands on a nightmare moon where an unheard pulse floods their minds, and finds survivors pinned down by something that answers every signal with a blast.

story.title: The Girl on the Platform
story.blurb: Coming home after a year away, a traveler steps off the train because his old love beckons from the platform. On the dark road, she is nowhere.

short.title: The Seal Chaser
short.blurb: During a circus diving act, an outlandish spectator bolts from his seat to catch the performing seal before she bites somebody, and chases her up to the tank.

story.title: The Runaway Balloon
story.blurb: A balloon snaps its cable with eight passengers aboard, and a young circus flier powers up his steel-winged machine to chase it above the clouds.

story.title: The Challenger's Category
story.blurb: Sealed in a soundproof force field, an undefeated stamp expert faces a challenger whose chosen category is the planet Mars, with questions no human has seen.
story.brokenNote: Cuts off mid-sentence during the first round of questions, before the contest turns or resolves anything.

story.title: The Princess Who Feared Daylight
story.blurb: A slighted fairy decrees that a wished-for princess must not see daylight before fifteen, so she rides to her lovesick prince in a coach without windows.

short.title: Three Knocks at Midnight
short.blurb: A storm howls around a country house at midnight when three loud knocks sound at the door, and a stranger enters dressed, for an instant, in rainbow colors.

short.title: No Big Elk Boy
short.blurb: Held as a spy by one prickly cow town, a scrawny stranger fights back the only way he knows: insulting it to its face, at length.

short.title: The Dream in the Marble Room
short.blurb: In a dream she wears another woman's jewels and waits, half in terror, for a turbaned stranger whose gift carries a serpent's fascination.

story.title: The Princess and the Genie
story.blurb: With the boarding house empty for one afternoon, a lonely lodger and a slangy errand boy transform the dreary parlor into an enchanted palace.

story.title: Open and Shut
story.blurb: A man lies shot dead in the road, his killer found sprawled senseless beside the rifle. The sheriff waits alone with the evidence while a mob gathers outside.

story.title: A Pint of Water
story.blurb: Left behind on a desert march, a fainting traveler begs the passing thousands for water and is mocked, until one young stranger stops beside him.

short.title: The Dropped Match
short.blurb: Sleepless past midnight, Margot drops a burning match beside her bed and leans over to find it. Something in the dark finds it first.

story.title: Her Uncle's House
story.blurb: Off the night train from the farm, Ellen follows her suave uncle into a big echoing house where lights burn low and the housekeeper hints at secrets.

short.title: When the Clock Struck Twelve
short.blurb: The old house is deadly still until the clock strikes twelve, and then come clanking chains, breaking crockery, and a screech no honest thing could make.
short.brokenNote: Cuts off mid-sentence just as the narrator steps into the hall, before the noises are faced or explained.

short.title: The Spider's Thread
short.blurb: From the lotus pond of Paradise, the Buddha looks straight down into Hell and remembers the one good deed of a robber squirming below.

story.title: The Devil's Flowers
story.blurb: A friendly foreign priest tends a field of nameless purple flowers and offers a passing cattle dealer a simple wager: guess what they are.

short.title: The Great Flea Campaign
short.blurb: Plagued by fleas in a Soho lodging, a man of odd practicality goes to war armed with treacle, newspaper, and a flash of genius.

short.title: The Man with Beautiful Hands
short.blurb: A car lies wrecked in the night. Its passenger steps out, checks each finger of his exquisite hands, and only then glances at his bleeding chauffeur.

short.title: The New Year's Kiss
short.blurb: A hurt boy lies in a hospital bed on New Year's morning, and a motherly nurse's small kindness undoes him completely.

short.title: Four Wild Horses
short.blurb: Plotting revenge on the road, a lady's maid collides with the handsome gentleman hunting for her mistress's address, and decides wild horses will not drag it from her.
short.brokenNote: The passage stops mid-sentence in the closing line of dialogue, leaving her final speech unfinished.

story.title: The Cup of Gyptis
story.blurb: A Greek ship led by a priestess searches a coastline for an empty harbour, and finds a king's feast where a princess must choose her husband by handing a cup.

78115.pairNote: A boyhood bear hunt on the ice and a fleet battle decades later; they share nothing but the man.

short.title: The Boy and the Bear
short.blurb: Ice-bound on a polar expedition, a fearless midshipman slips off the ship at midnight with one rusty musket, determined to bring home a bear's skin for his father.

story.title: The Blind Eye
story.blurb: Ships run aground, pilots lose their nerve, and a distant admiral signals retreat. Amid the smoke, a one-eyed commander raises a telescope and chooses not to see.

story.title: A Long Walk in Tight Boots
story.blurb: Cowboys who hate walking jog miles through the dark in tight boots, trailing a rival's horse to steal a glimpse of his secret trick-riding stunt.

story.title: Pup Night
story.blurb: On the second night of term, hazers corner a sobbing younger boy in the dark road, and a newcomer decides this has gone far enough.

story.title: The Door in the Tree
story.blurb: A cheerfully useless guide gets two children lost beneath twisted grey trees, where they find a small rusted door set into the biggest trunk of all.

78124.pairNote: Separate centuries and separate jokes in the same parody register; neither dulls the other.

short.title: The Invention of the Navy
short.blurb: A gloriously muddled history lesson in which King Arthur invents conferences, Alfred builds longer ships than the Danes, and the defeated are made romantic by decree.

story.title: Wrong but Wromantic
story.blurb: The Civil War explained at last: Cavaliers are Wrong but Wromantic, Roundheads Right but Repulsive, and under these circumstances war is inevitable.

story.title: Awake in the Dark
story.blurb: A famous barrister wakes in pitch dark in a bunk that is not his bed, certain of yesterday's appointments and nothing else, least of all where he is.
